contract.expected: Vault MP4 upload → Media Vault + catalog/Trending only; Hero changes only via explicit Set as Hero / commitHeroAssetSelection
contract.observedSymptom: Newest Vault MP4 appears to become Hero background automatically

pipelineTrace.finding: Default category is Trending (vaultUploadCategory = 'Trending'). formData.append('category', vaultUploadCategory || 'Trending'). Does NOT call commitHeroAssetSelection / commitHeroVideoIdentity / selectHeroAsset / saveHeroReel.
Content vault path. HeroExperience alone appends category HERO for dedicated hero uploads.
After catalog sync / ws CREATED, feed updates. Mount always ends with applyHeroIntelligence(true).
Asset mode HeroRecord is authoritative in resolveHeroBackgroundAsset. Selection mode is NOT a user override (hasUserHeroOverride returns false for selection).

When HeroRecord.mode === 'selection' (or manager backgroundSource === 'selection'), intelligence/selection presentation may set HERO_BACKGROUND_VIDEO / heroRenderVideo from selectHeroContent(...).videoUrl — which can track a newly ingested feed reel.

newestVideo_as_recovery_pick.note: Vault newest is gathered but intentionally NOT selected in current recovery code. Residual risk if that guard regresses.

heroPersistenceProtection.gap: Manual UI that only sets manager fields / leaves mode=selection does not lock hero against feed-driven selection after vault ingest.

path: Vault MP4 accepted → personalVideos + catalog/feed gain new reel
selectHeroContent(mode, feed) builds candidates from feed/episode links (featured_series, studio_priority, trending, …)
If HeroRecord.mode !== 'asset' and !== 'none': applyHeroSelection writes selection.videoUrl into HERO_BACKGROUND_VIDEO
HeroExperience: backgroundSource==='selection' → resolveSelectionHeroBackgroundPresentation uses that selection video; OR store fallback $HERO_BACKGROUND_VIDEO

secondaryRiskPaths.detail: Manager heroAssetId/custom_video without durable HeroRecord.mode=asset → hasUserHeroOverride false → intelligence can still rebind runtime background.
sealVaultSeriesIdentityForStorage / vault series inference can bind new reelId onto episodes; candidateFromEpisode then surfaces that reel as selection.videoUrl.
applyServerPresentationToHeroRecord → selectHeroAsset can rewrite HeroRecord from remote; not vault-upload itself but can amplify post-sync churn.

notTheCause: Vault processVaultVideoFile writing category=HERO (it does not)

surgicalChanges.change: In applyHeroIntelligence / applyHeroBackgroundFromIntelligence / rotation callback: if loadHeroRecord().mode === 'asset' OR durable manager custom_video+heroAssetId is locked, never call applyHeroSelection with applyBackground true. Treat durable custom hero like hasUserHeroOverride.

Widen hasUserHeroOverride (or add hasLockedHeroBackground) to true when HeroRecord.mode==='asset' OR (backgroundSource in custom_video|custom_image AND non-empty heroAssetId). Selection mode remains free to rotate.
Keep/strengthen: never select personal_video_vault / reelforge_feed candidates for recovery; only reelforge_hero_reel or explicit committed assetId.
When locked custom hero exists, do not fall back heroRenderVideo to $HERO_BACKGROUND_VIDEO if that store was polluted by selection intelligence.
